high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the Indian Defence Research Wing, dated 18 hours prior to the time of the screenshot. The headline reads: "Dr. Samir V. Kamat Announces Tejas MkII First Flight Scheduled for Q1 2026." The main focus of the image is a 3D rendering of an aircraft, specifically the Tejas MkII, which is a multirole fighter jet developed by India. The aircraft is depicted in a dark gray color with various armaments attached to its wings and fuselage. The armaments include what appear to be missiles and possibly fuel tanks
